versions.content: When processing the go-to-sleep command, the function LinIf_MainFunction_<LinIfChannel.ShortName> shall call the function Lin_GetStatus of the LIN Driver module, after the delay of the sleep mode frame has passed. When the return code of the function Lin_GetStatus is not LIN_CH_SLEEP, the go-to-sleep command transmission has failed.
